verdict.rationale: SES explicitly documents a sandbox environment where new accounts can use all SES features but can only send to verified identities, letting users test without affecting real recipients/production data, with a clear path to request production access (docs-13, docs-22, docs-41, docs-14). This directly matches the story's intent of a safe test environment separate from production. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation specifically of the sandbox testing workflow (community evidence discusses deliverability/production issues, not sandbox testing itself).
